name: nsr_decide
description: Make an auditable decision for one action. An exact authorization_goal binds the requested subject. Returns approved, denied, or refused; approvals can include a verifiable_bundle for nsr_verify_proof. A refusal may name missing_facts. Set shadow:true for a trial that must not authorize action.

name: nsr_verify_proof
description: Independently verify a decision's verifiable_bundle. Pass facts, rules, proof, and org_id verbatim from that bundle. Returns verified:true or verified:false with a reason.

name: nsr_verify_plan
description: Check every step of a consequential plan before executing any step. One denied or refused step blocks the whole plan. Returns plan_verdict and blocked_steps.

name: nsr_record_outcome_by_ref
description: Record what happened to a past decision using the external_ref supplied when it was made. Outcomes include honored, reversed, overridden, and escalated.

name: nsr_batch_decide
description: Decide several cases in one request against one policy snapshot. Each item is a full decision request. Returns a per-item verdict and a summary.

name: nsr_refusal_gaps
description: Read-only analytics: aggregate the missing premises behind recent refused decisions, ordered by frequency.

name: nsr_lint_rule
description: Validate a stored-shape rule without installing it. Reports diagnostics and has_errors. Stored rule atoms use predicate and args, unlike request-scoped if/then rules.

name: nsr_add_fact
description: Write a fact into the organization's knowledge base. This mutates policy evidence and must not be used to fabricate a missing premise.

name: nsr_add_rule
description: Install a stored rule into the organization's knowledge base. Lint and review a proposed rule before this mutation.
